text:
The schedule below satisfies all twelve constraints. I re-checked each one against it.

The constraints give two chains: Ivo < Ann < Elif < Gus < Hana, and Finn < Ben < Dev with Cara immediately after Dev. Interleaving them puts Hana and Cara late, as the team note says.

1. Finn in slot 1 fails for every placement of Elif, so Finn takes slot 2.
2. Elif then has to be in slot 5 or later, and Elif = 5 works.
3. Cara must be exactly two slots from Elif and at least three from Finn, so Cara = 7 and Dev = 6.
4. Gus and Hana come after Elif, so they take slots 8 and 9, with Gus first.
5. Ivo, Ann and Ben fill slots 1, 3 and 4. Ivo must precede Ann, and Ben must be at least three slots from Ivo, so Ivo = 1, Ann = 3 and Ben = 4.

Constraint checks:
- Cara (7) and Elif (5) have exactly one person between them, Dev in slot 6.
- Ann (3) and Hana (9) are 6 apart.
- Gus (8) is before Hana (9).
- Ann (3) is before Elif (5).
- Finn (2) is before Ben (4).
- Elif (5) is before Gus (8).
- Cara (7) and Finn (2) are 5 apart.
- Elif (5) and Finn (2) are 3 apart.
- Ivo (1) is before Ann (3).
- Cara (7) is immediately after Dev (6).
- Ben (4) is before Dev (6).
- Ben (4) and Ivo (1) are 3 apart.
